INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.TITLE: Interview Dashboard
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.SUBTITLE: Track interview preparation, execution, results and operational issues in one place. Figures only include the data you are authorized to see.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.ACTIONS.EXPORT_PDF_H: Opens the print dialog - choose "Save as PDF" as the destination.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.FILTERS.TITLE: Filters
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.FILTERS.SETUP_HINT: Template and committee counters only respond to the job, committee and schedule filters.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.HELP.SCHEDULED_CANDI: Appointments with an assigned candidate, excluding cancelled and superseded (rescheduled) appointments.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.HELP.PRESENT: Scheduled candidates whose attendance was recorded as Present.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.HELP.NO_SHOW: Scheduled candidates whose attendance was recorded as No-show.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.HELP.EVALUATIONS_COM: Candidates whose evaluation is complete - every participating committee member has submitted.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.HELP.HIRING: Candidates whose final decision in an approved result report is "Candidate for hiring process".
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.HELP.WAITING_LIST: Candidates whose final decision is "Waiting list".
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.HELP.OPEN_ISSUES: Operational issues on the filtered interviews that are still open (not resolved or waived).
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.HELP.APPROVED_TEMPLA: Active evaluation templates that have an approved version.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.HELP.SCHEDULED_SCHED: Interview schedules that are approved or ready for execution.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.HELP.IN_PROGRESS_SCH: Interview schedules whose execution is in progress.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.HELP.INTERVIEWS_COMP: Candidates whose interview has been held (under evaluation, completed or closed).
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.HELP.RESCHEDULED: Appointments that were moved to a new time. The new appointment is counted with the scheduled candidates.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.HELP.NEEDS_ACTION: Candidates in result reports whose final decision is "Needs action".
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.REPORTS.INTRO.SCHEDU: Execution progress of each interview schedule. Counts cover all of the schedule's candidates.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.REPORTS.INTRO.CANDID: Each scheduled candidate with attendance, interview status and evaluation progress.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.REPORTS.INTRO.RESULT: Candidates in interview result reports with their final score and decision.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.REPORTS.INTRO.ISSUES: Operational issues raised during interviews, open issues first.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.EMPTY.NO_DATA: No data for the selected filters.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.EMPTY.NO_ACTIVITY: No interview activity for the selected filters.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.EMPTY.NO_RECORDS: No records match the selected filters.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.EMPTY.NO_SECTIONS: You don't have access to any interview indicators.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.ERROR.TITLE: The dashboard couldn't be loaded
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.ERROR.MESSAGE: Something went wrong while loading the interview figures. Please try again.
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.PRINT.SUBTITLE: Interview module report
INTERVIEW_DASHBOARD.PRINT.NO_FILTERS: None - all data you are authorized to see
